sentences.en: There's a reason this product is so well-received by women all over the world!

sentences.en: This great baby shower craft is always well-received by the mom-to-be and shower guests.

sentences.en: Teens almost always need funds, so an addition to the balance on their Visa Buxx card would be a well-received gift.

sentences.en: You may also want to consider the bride's personality and the group of attendees to make sure the card game is appropriate and well-received.

sentences.en: Hill released It Matters to Me in 1995, and it was also well-received.

sentences.en: Faith's next two albums, Breathe and Faith were well-received by both country listeners and pop fans.

sentences.en: Will her singing be as well-received as her acting?

sentences.en: He started hosting Late Night with Conan O'Brien in 1993, and while the show was not well-received initially, it is now enjoying its 14th season.

sentences.en: She recently snagged an Emmy win, however, her acceptance speech at the Creative Arts Emmy Awards ceremony was not well-received by everyone.

sentences.en: The song, which featured fiancé Spencer Pratt rapping, was well-received by listeners, but Montag insisted it was not the authorized version for airplay.
